<mxfile host="Electron"> <diagram id="ExGWa2KxNiuBWYgc49XM" name="第 1 页"> <mxGraphModel dx="3734" dy="2016" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "flowchart TD
 Start([\"用户输入 ls -l | grep ^d > output.txt\"])
 ShellParse[\"Shell 解析命令，识别管道和重定向\"]
 PipeCreate[\"调用 pipe() 创建无名管道<br/>内核: sys_pipe → get_pipe_inode\"]
 ForkLs[\"fork() 创建 ls 子进程<br/>内核: copy_process + copy_page_tables (COW)\"]
 ForkGrep[\"fork() 创建 grep 子进程<br/>内核: copy_process + copy_page_tables (COW)\"]
 ParentClose[\"父进程 close(pipefd[0]), close(pipefd[1])\"]
 
 ForkLs --> LsPath[\"ls 子进程路径\"]
 ForkGrep --> GrepPath[\"grep 子进程路径\"]
 
 LsPath --> LsDup[\"dup2(pipefd[1], 1)<br/>stdout → 管道写端\"]
 LsDup --> LsExec[\"execve('/bin/ls')<br/>内核: do_execve → do_mmap\"]
 LsExec --> LsPageFault[\"缺页异常 #PF<br/>do_no_page → read_page → bread\"]
 LsPageFault --> LsDiskRead[\"磁盘 I/O: ll_rw_block 启动 DMA\"]
 LsDiskRead --> LsReady[\"ls 代码就绪，开始执行\"]
 
 GrepPath --> GrepOpen[\"open('output.txt', O_CREAT|O_TRUNC)<br/>内核: namei → new_inode → alloc_block\"]
 GrepOpen --> GrepDup[\"dup2(pipefd[0], 0) → stdin 来自管道<br/>dup2(3, 1) → stdout 到文件<br/>close(3)\"]
 GrepDup --> GrepExec[\"execve('/bin/grep')<br/>内核: do_execve → do_mmap\"]
 GrepExec --> GrepPageFault[\"缺页异常 #PF<br/>do_no_page → read_page → bread\"]
 GrepPageFault --> GrepDiskRead[\"磁盘 I/O: ll_rw_block 启动 DMA\"]
 GrepDiskRead --> GrepReady[\"grep 代码就绪，开始执行\"]
 
 LsReady --> LsOpenDir[\"open('.') 打开当前目录\"]
 LsOpenDir --> LsLoop{\"遍历目录项\"}
 LsLoop --> LsGetdents[\"getdents() → minix_dir_read()<br/>bread() 读取目录块\"]
 LsGetdents --> LsStat[\"stat(filename) → namei 获取 inode\"]
 LsStat --> LsLoop
 LsLoop -->|\"遍历完成\"| LsFormat[\"格式化输出\"]
 
 GrepReady --> GrepRegcomp[\"regcomp('^d') 编译正则表达式\"]
 GrepRegcomp --> GrepLoop{\"fgets() 从管道读取一行\"}
 GrepLoop -->|\"读取成功\"| GrepRegexec[\"regexec() 执行匹配\"]
 GrepRegexec --> GrepMatch{\"匹配成功?\"}
 GrepMatch -->|\"是\"| GrepWrite[\"fputs() 写入 stdout → file_write\"]
 GrepMatch -->|\"否\"| GrepLoop
 GrepWrite --> GrepLoop
 GrepLoop -->|\"EOF (管道关闭)\"| GrepDone[\"grep 读取完成\"]
 
 LsFormat --> LsWrite[\"write(pipefd[1]) → pipe_write()\"]
 LsWrite --> PipeFull{\"管道缓冲区满?\"}
 PipeFull -->|\"是\"| LsSleep[\"ls 睡眠 (TASK_INTERRUPTIBLE)<br/>schedule() 切换进程\"]
 PipeFull -->|\"否\"| LsCopy[\"数据复制到环形缓冲区<br/>更新 PIPE_HEAD<br/>唤醒 grep\"]
 LsSleep --> LsCopy
 
 GrepLoop --> PipeEmpty{\"管道缓冲区空?\"}
 PipeEmpty -->|\"是\"| GrepSleep[\"grep 睡眠 (TASK_INTERRUPTIBLE)<br/>schedule() 切换进程\"]
 PipeEmpty -->|\"否\"| GrepCopy[\"从环形缓冲区复制数据<br/>更新 PIPE_TAIL<br/>唤醒 ls\"]
 GrepSleep --> GrepCopy
 
 LsCopy --> LsExit[\"ls 写完成，调用 exit()\"]
 LsExit --> LsDoExit[\"内核: do_exit()<br/>释放页表，关闭文件<br/>状态 → TASK_ZOMBIE<br/>向父进程发送 SIGCHLD\"]
 LsDoExit --> LsSched[\"schedule() 切换进程\"]
 
 GrepDone --> GrepExit[\"grep 调用 exit()\"]
 GrepExit --> GrepDoExit[\"内核: do_exit()<br/>释放资源<br/>状态 → TASK_ZOMBIE<br/>发送 SIGCHLD\"]
 
 LsSched --> ShellWait[\"Shell 调用 waitpid()\"]
 GrepDoExit --> ShellWait
 ShellWait --> WaitLoop{\"有 ZOMBIE 子进程?\"}
 WaitLoop -->|\"是\"| Reap[\"获取退出状态<br/>free_page 释放 task_struct 和内核栈\"]
 WaitLoop -->|\"否\"| ShellSleep[\"Shell 睡眠等待\"]
 ShellSleep --> WaitLoop
 Reap --> ShellPrompt[\"Shell 输出下一命令提示符\"]
 
 Start --> ShellParse --> PipeCreate --> ForkLs
 PipeCreate --> ForkGrep
 ForkLs --> ParentClose
 ForkGrep --> ParentClose",
 "config": null
